description: FREE headline check of your own agent deployment's observability readiness (100/day per wallet; pass caller). Submit your config and/or a sample trace; get the verdict line, readiness score, and which of the four auditor record types are present/absent/misshaped. Evidence and the fix list are in the paid report. The check verifies record emission and shape only — it does not certify that an agent is safe.

caller.description: Solana base58 wallet of the operator; keys the free allowance (100/day per wallet).

config.description: Optional object: the deployment's framework/config description (key/value).

deployment_label.description: Optional short label for the deployment, echoed in the report.

framework.description: Optional label for the deployment's framework (descriptive only).

trace.description: Optional array of event objects: a sample trace/log the operator generated.

trace_text.description: Optional string: the sample trace as JSONL or raw log lines.

name: observability_precheck
